messages:
Maya Rivera: Hi team — adoption finalized in Colombia 2026-05-20. How do I add the child to benefits? Can coverage be retroactive to the finalization date? Docs are in Spanish and current custody decree is still being translated.
Samira Khan: Congrats Maya!! :tada: For adoption QLEs we need the adoption decree + proof of finalization. Standard QLE window is 30 days from the finalization event to submit docs, but for international adoptions we can extend to 60 days if translation/certification delays are reasonable. Please upload asap.
Maya Rivera: Thanks. What specific docs do you need besides the decree? Will a scan of the Spanish decree + a rough machine translation be ok for initial processing?
Samira Khan: Required: certified copy of the adoption decree (or court order), child's passport or birth record if available, and proof of legal custody/guardianship. If you only have a Spanish decree right now, upload that plus a machine translation; we'll accept it for intake and can start retro coverage review. Final approval requires a certified English translation or a translator affidavit.
BenefitsAdmin: Note on benefits: medical + vision + dental enrollments require a dependent enrollment form (e-sign) and child info for carrier submission. We'll send DocuSign after we validate docs. Retro coverage: we can request carrier retro effective date equal to finalization, but carrier approval is not guaranteed. We'll attempt to backdate to 2026-05-20 once we have the decree.
Maya Rivera: I live overseas right now; do you need notarized apostille? Colombia issues apostilles, but it may take weeks.
Samira Khan: Apostille is preferred for international court documents. If you can't get an apostille within the 30-day window, upload the decree and explanation and we'll log an extension request. Keep evidence of your apostille request timeline.
PayrollOps: For payroll/tax: carriers usually need SSN for the dependent long-term. We can enroll the child without SSN initially, but you must provide SSN or ITIN when available. If the child will get a US SSN later, upload it to the secure portal so we can update payroll/benefit deduction records.
Maya Rivera: Uploaded today: "1766009876_maya_colombia_adoption.pdf" to the secure portal (Spanish decree + passport page + rough Google Translate). Sent a note about apostille timeline.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: Do not post PII in channels. Use secure upload: https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload. QLE docs should include event date.
Samira Khan: Got the upload, thanks. We'll start an intake review and queue it for carrier submission. Expect DocuSign from BenefitsAdmin within 2 business days. If carrier needs certified translation or apostille, we'll request it, but won't delay the initial DocuSign.
BenefitsAdmin: Processing now. If carrier denies retro request, we'll confirm effective date and next steps (appeals window varies by carrier). We'll keep you updated in this thread.
Maya Rivera: Thank you all — appreciate the help. I'll follow up if apostille takes longer than a week. :pray:
